description:
Stay Authentic and Natural With Custom Kraft Stickers

Emphasize your brand’s authenticity while saving the environment with custom kraft stickers. These stickers are durable, eco-friendly, and crafted from 100% recycled material. If you’re going for a natural, organic, and homemade look, kraft stickers are an excellent choice.

Customize your kraft stickers by adding your logo, tagline, or a unique design. These stickers come in a roll format, making them ideal for large-volume distribution. Use these as freebies in purchases, party favors, promotions to hand out to customers, or as a thank-you note that you can add as a finishing touch to product packaging.

Features That Will Get Your Marketing on a Roll

Our kraft stickers are easy to customize and tailor based on your brand identity. Explore the features below to kickstart your promotions:

Diverse Standard Shapes and Sizes
We can print your stickers in rectangle, square, circle, or oval shape, or you can opt for a custom shape. These stickers are also available in sizes ranging from 0.5" x 0.5" up to 8.5" x 11". If you have a specific dimension in mind, select the "Custom" option in the product calculator. 

Superior Adhesion
Our kraft stickers feature a water-based permanent acrylic adhesive that provides strong adhesion to wet surfaces or low temperatures, making them suitable for cold and wet storage.

Sticks to Most Surfaces
Kraft stickers can be applied to most surfaces. They're primarily designed for glass containers, but you can use them in food packaging, soap packaging, candles, and other artisanal products.

Fast and Easy Application
With its convenient roll format, kraft stickers are not only fast and easy to apply – they're also very cost-effective. You can order as many as 100,000 pieces for higher-volume inventories or print as few as 250 pieces.


Let UPrinting handle all your sticker printing needs. You can upload your logo or artwork to our website or create a unique design using our online design tool. We'll also send you an online proof before we put your stickers into production. Order kraft stickers today; we'll have them shipped in 2-6 business days.
